title: Full-Step-DPO: Self-Supervised Preference Optimization with Step-wise Rewards for Mathematical Reasoning
authors_zh: Huimin Xu, Xin Mao, Feng-Lin Li, Xiaobao Wu, Wang Chen, Wei Zhang, Anh Tuan Luu
paper_type_zh: 自监督逐步骤偏好优化研究
best_for_zh: 希望从推理 rollout 构造过程监督偏好信号、又不依赖 GPT-4 或人工步骤标签的读者。
one_line: Full-Step-DPO uses a self-supervised process reward model to score every reasoning step and weight preference optimization across the full chain.
Full-Step-DPO 使用自监督过程奖励模型为每个推理步骤打分，并在整条推理链上加权偏好优化。
why: It changes both the construction and training consumer of reasoning preference data by retaining reward information from every step.
inclusion_reason: It transforms full reasoning solutions into step-scored preference records and makes all steps, rather than one first error, contribute to preference optimization.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Solution-level DPO treats a long reasoning chain as one indivisible preference record. Step-DPO improves granularity by targeting the first erroneous step, but leaves later correct or incorrect steps unused and often needs humans or GPT-4 to identify that first error. This wastes process information and makes fine-grained data construction costly when many reasoning paths must be annotated.

The paper asks how to turn every useful step in a reasoning chain into preference supervision without an external step annotator. It trains a self-supervised process reward model from sampled solutions and final-answer signals, uses that model to score the full chain, and gives all steps a reward-sensitive contribution to optimization. The objective is therefore not merely to identify an error location, but to retain graded evidence from the entire solution trajectory.

解答级 DPO 将一条长推理链视为不可分割的偏好记录。Step-DPO 通过针对第一个错误步骤改善粒度，但会让之后正确或错误的步骤未被使用，并且常需要人类或 GPT-4 识别该第一个错误。这浪费了过程信息，也使得当必须标注大量推理路径时，细粒度数据构造成本高昂。

论文要回答的是：如何在没有外部步骤标注者的情况下，将一条推理链中每个有用步骤转化为偏好监督。它从采样解答和最终答案信号训练自监督过程奖励模型，用该模型为完整链条打分，并使所有步骤都以对奖励敏感的方式贡献于优化。因此，目标不只是识别一个错误位置，而是保留整个解答轨迹中的分级证据。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Full-Step-DPO treats a reasoning solution as a sequence of supervised decisions with unequal value. The process reward model assigns a score to each step, so a chain is not reduced to a binary correct/incorrect response or to one first mistake. Higher-quality steps can reinforce the policy while lower-quality steps receive a different gradient contribution, preserving information that ordinary DPO and first-error-only construction discard.

The key is that the step scorer is self-supervised. Instead of requesting a human or a frontier model to annotate each transition, the method derives process-reward training data from generated reasoning and verifiable terminal answers. It then uses the scorer both to select high- and low-quality solutions and to weight all stepwise terms in the preference loss. Selection and consumption are consequently coupled through one learned process signal.

Full-Step-DPO 将一个推理解答视为一系列价值不等的受监督决策。过程奖励模型为每一步分配分数，因此一条链不会被压缩为二元的正确、错误回答，也不会只压缩为第一个错误。质量更高的步骤可以强化策略，而质量较低的步骤获得不同的梯度贡献，保留了普通 DPO 和仅关注第一个错误的数据构造会丢弃的信息。

关键在于步骤评分器是自监督的。该方法不请求人类或前沿模型标注每次转移，而是从生成的推理和可验证的终止答案中导出过程奖励训练数据。随后，它同时用评分器选择高低质量解答，并为偏好损失中的全部逐步骤项加权。选择与消费因而通过同一个学习到的过程信号耦合起来。

title: Method
方法
html:
The method first samples reasoning solutions for mathematical questions and constructs process-reward examples from their intermediate steps and terminal correctness. A self-supervised process reward model is trained to score each step, avoiding external step-level labels. It scores candidate chains, aggregates their process quality, and selects high-scoring and low-scoring solutions to form preference pairs. The PRM therefore supplies both a record-construction signal and a step-level value sequence.

Full-Step-DPO then replaces the whole-solution log-ratio with a sum whose step terms are dynamically weighted by those rewards. All steps in the chosen and rejected chains participate, unlike Step-DPO's first-error focus. The authors use the same Step-DPO training prompts for comparison, train with self-generated PRM data, and evaluate in-domain as well as MetaMath, MMIQC, GK2023, OCW, and other out-of-domain mathematical settings.

该方法首先针对数学问题采样推理解答，并从其中间步骤和终止正确性构造过程奖励样本。一个自监督过程奖励模型被训练为每一步打分，从而避免外部步骤级标签。它为候选链条评分，聚合其过程质量，并选择高分和低分解答形成偏好对。因此，过程奖励模型同时提供记录构造信号和步骤级价值序列。

随后，Full-Step-DPO 用一个由这些奖励动态加权的逐步骤项之和，替换完整解答的对数比。入选和拒绝链条中的所有步骤都参与，而不是像 Step-DPO 一样只关注第一个错误。作者为比较使用相同的 Step-DPO 训练提示，用自生成的过程奖励模型数据训练，并在域内以及 MetaMath、MMIQC、GK2023、OCW 和其他域外数学设置上评测。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper reports that Full-Step-DPO exceeds solution-level DPO, Step-DPO, and other baselines on its in-domain mathematical tasks across several base models. It also evaluates out of domain on GK2023 and OCW and reports stronger performance in nearly all listed settings, with further results on five additional mathematical datasets. The released PRM achieves 84.3 percent accuracy on GSM8K and 33.2 percent on MATH in the reported process-scoring evaluation, showing that self-supervision yields a usable, though imperfect, step signal.

The analyses connect results to full-chain consumption. Compared with optimizing only the first erroneous step, weighting every step yields better preference-learning performance; the authors also show that the PRM can score and filter solutions for best-of-eight decoding. They report that self-generated process data lowers the construction cost relative to external step annotation. At the same time, analyses show PRM benefit diminishes for very strong base models and that later inference stages remain hard for the scorer, delimiting the evidence.

论文报告，在多个基础模型上，Full-Step-DPO 在域内数学任务中超过解答级 DPO、Step-DPO 和其他基线。它还在 GK2023 和 OCW 上进行域外评测，并报告在几乎所有列出的设置中表现更强，另外还给出五个数学数据集的结果。已发布的过程奖励模型在报告的过程评分评测中，在 GSM8K 上达到 84.3% 准确率，在 MATH 上达到 33.2%，表明自监督产生了可用但并不完美的步骤信号。

分析将结果与完整链条消费联系起来。与只优化第一个错误步骤相比，对每一步加权带来更好的偏好学习表现；作者还表明过程奖励模型可为最佳八选一解码评分和过滤解答。他们报告，自生成过程数据相对外部步骤标注降低了构造成本。与此同时，分析显示对于很强的基础模型，过程奖励模型的收益会减弱，并且评分器仍难以处理推理后期阶段，这限定了证据范围。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The main novelty is to make the full process-reward trajectory part of a DPO-style training record. Earlier solution-level records retain only an outcome, and first-error records retain only one transition. Full-Step-DPO records a reward sequence and uses it to decide both which solutions form a pair and how each step inside that pair affects the gradient. This is a genuine change in supervision granularity and in the training consumer.

The self-supervised PRM is the other central choice. It is not merely an auxiliary evaluator: it replaces expensive external step annotation in constructing the data and supplies the weights that remain active in optimization. The method therefore ties data generation, filtering, and loss shaping to one source of evidence. Its value is strongest where final-answer verification can provide an initial trustworthy signal for process-reward learning.

主要新意是让完整的过程奖励轨迹成为类 DPO 训练记录的一部分。早期解答级记录只保留结果，第一个错误记录只保留一次转移。Full-Step-DPO 记录一个奖励序列，并用它同时决定哪些解答形成样本对，以及该样本对内部每一步如何影响梯度。这是真正改变监督粒度和训练消费者的做法。

自监督过程奖励模型是另一个核心选择。它不只是辅助评估器：它在数据构造中替代昂贵的外部步骤标注，并提供在优化中保持活跃的权重。因此，该方法将数据生成、过滤和损失塑形绑定到同一种证据来源。其价值在最终答案验证能够为过程奖励学习提供初始可信信号的场景中最为突出。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Self-supervised step rewards inherit errors from the final-answer signal and may become less helpful when the base model is already very strong. The paper notes that discriminative reward models can outperform its PRM in some settings and that later reasoning stages remain difficult to score. Evidence concentrates on mathematical reasoning, while code generation and other domains are future work. Reuse also depends on verifying the legality and distribution of the underlying math prompts and generated solutions.
自监督步骤奖励会继承最终答案信号中的错误，当基础模型已经很强时可能变得不那么有帮助。论文指出，判别式奖励模型在一些设置中可以超过其过程奖励模型，并且推理后期阶段仍难以评分。证据集中于数学推理，代码生成和其他领域仍是未来工作。复用还依赖于核验底层数学提示和生成解答的合法性与分布。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this method when reasoning traces have verifiable end states but manual or frontier-model step labels are too costly. It provides a route from terminal correctness to process-scored pairs and a mechanism for using every step rather than throwing away information after the first error. Before adoption, validate PRM calibration on held-out traces, compare full-step weighting with first-error and outcome-only controls, measure the cost of sampling and scoring, and inspect whether selected low-scoring solutions contain useful errors rather than malformed text.
当推理轨迹具有可验证终止状态，但人工或前沿模型的步骤标签成本过高时，可以使用该方法。它提供从终止正确性到过程评分样本对的路径，并提供使用每一步而不是在第一个错误后丢弃信息的机制。在采用前，应在留出轨迹上验证过程奖励模型校准，与第一个错误和仅结果控制比较完整步骤加权，测量采样与评分成本，并检查入选的低分解答是否包含有用错误而非格式错误文本。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read Sections 3.3 and 3.4 together: the crucial artifact is a step-reward sequence that serves both pair construction and loss weighting. Then compare the PRM analysis with the in-domain and out-of-domain tables, because a good final score does not by itself establish reliable process labels. A reproduction should record the solution sampler, terminal verifier, PRM training data, solution-selection rule, reward normalization, and each step's loss weight; otherwise the phrase "full-step" does not specify the actual training signal.
应将第 3.3 节和第 3.4 节结合阅读：关键制品是一个既服务于样本对构造、又服务于损失加权的步骤奖励序列。随后将过程奖励模型分析与域内、域外表格比较，因为好的最终分数本身不能建立可靠的过程标签。复现应记录解答采样器、终止验证器、过程奖励模型训练数据、解答选择规则、奖励归一化和每一步损失权重；否则“完整步骤”这一说法并未指明实际训练信号。
